title: DOW-UAP-PR102, Unresolved UAP Report, East China Sea, 2024
what_is_it: A short infrared video clip and accompanying case-status write-up documenting an unresolved unidentified anomalous phenomenon (UAP) sighting.
interpretation_warnings: The document explicitly states its description is informational only and should not be read as an analytical judgement, investigative conclusion, or factual determination about the event.
Single-source: derived from one sensor clip submitted by one military command; no corroborating data provided.
No underlying analytical text was extractable from the PDF; facts rely on war.gov metadata and the brief video description.
The tracked object is described only as an 'area of contrast' — the source makes no claim about its identity, size, distance, or nature.
Case is unresolved, meaning no explanation has been reached, not that the phenomenon is anomalous or unexplainable in principle.

key_facts.source_quote: aboard a U.S. military platform in 2024
